story.title: Digi Yatra Develops AI-Powered E-Passport Enrolment and Facial Verification System for International Travel
story.summary: Digi Yatra Foundation has shared new details of its proposed international travel system, which includes e-passport enrolment, AI-based facial verification, and token-based identity sharing to streamline border crossings for Indian travellers. The system builds on Digi Yatra's existing domestic airport face-recognition infrastructure, extending its ambition from domestic terminals to cross-border identity management. Privacy advocates are monitoring how biometric tokens will be stored, shared, and deleted across jurisdictions.
